rules: Do not change legacy results or checker files; new versioned evidence only.
Checker revisions must come from its author role and retain prior source, feedback and rationale.
Functional event witnesses supplement raw coverage; never change or reinterpret original DUT counters.
Do not select new targets using C outcomes or reduce the old 6x64 budget to induce a B failure.
No solver/calibration witnesses or hidden checker controls in experimental prompts.
Failure of a prerequisite is a recorded rejection, not permission to start A/B/C/placebo.
FBYTE=0 retains meaning256. Uncompleted bursts remain pending; budget does not expand to finish them.
timing_rationale: Prospective before any live trial: THIGH>=4 for documented synchronization, TLOW>2 and TLOW>THD_DAT; reduced dimensionless synchronous fixture, not analog mode certification.
screen_control: Ordinary one-byte READB with address and STOP, in addition to old ordinary write. Require at least three distinct multistep event-to-group bindings, >=2 nontrivial groups; co-occurrence alone is insufficient. Not selected using B/C outcomes.
